_doc: How each kind of foe fights in a delve (Systems/Tactics.cs). A foe takes the first entry whose words appear in its id or whose types include its creature type. flee: below this share of its hp it breaks and runs (out of the fight). cover: extra AC for the first coverRounds rounds. pack: +1 to hit per other living packmate, up to pack. Bosses add signature (it spends round 2 on half a blow to every standing hero, dodged with a Dex save), minions (it spends round 3 calling more of its kind) and pride (a hero with the gift of the gab can goad it into talking, and the party gets a free round).

tactics.fled: The {foes} that are left break and scatter into the dark, shooting back over their shoulders.
tactics.signature: {boss} screams for the warren, and arrows rattle out of every crack in the walls
tactics.called: {boss} blows a horn, and {n} more goblins pour in from the side tunnels.

tactics.fled: The last of the {foes} bellow and run, leaving their dead.
tactics.signature: {boss} roars and swings in a great circle through the whole party

tactics.fled: The {foes} have had enough; they throw down a purse and run.
tactics.called: {boss} whistles, and {n} more cutthroats drop from the rafters.

tactics.fled: The {foes} that are left slink off with their tails down.
tactics.signature: {boss} and the whole pack come in at once from every side
{boss} looses a net of sticky web across the passage
{boss} breathes out the cold of the grave, and the torches gutter
tactics.called: {boss} speaks a word, and {n} skeletons claw their way up through the floor.

tactics.signature: {boss} draws a long breath and fills the cave with fire
tactics.goaded: {hero} calls out praise for {boss}'s hoard and its terrible beauty. The wyrm cannot help but answer, and while it gloats the party closes in.

tactics.signature: {boss} opens a mouth too wide and spits hellfire
tactics.called: The air splits, and {n} imps tumble through, cackling.

tactics.fled: The {foes} stumble off, shaking the ground.
tactics.signature: {boss} hurls a boulder that bowls through the party
{boss} rattles its spines and they burst, showering the party with violet shards

tactics.fled: The {foes} that are left scuttle back into their tunnels.
tactics.signature: {boss} shrieks, and the hive walls split open on every side
tactics.called: {n} more chitterkin burrow up through the floor.

tactics.fled: The {foes} lope off into the snow.
tactics.signature: {boss} roars, and the snow above comes down on the party

tactics.fled: The {foes} bow, laugh and vanish behind the painted cloths.
tactics.signature: {boss} throws up a dazzle of coloured fire and the whole tent spins
tactics.called: The music swells, and {n} masked revellers dance in from the dark.
tactics.goaded: {hero} heckles the show. {boss} cannot bear to be upstaged and stops to answer, and the party closes in.

tactics.fled: The last {foes} fall back, swearing the writ will find the party again.
tactics.signature: {boss} raises a burning writ, and the faithful charge as one
tactics.called: {boss} rings a handbell, and {n} more witch hunters come with brands and chains.

tactics.fled: The {foes} lose their nerve and flee their pulpit.
tactics.signature: {boss} preaches, and the words land like blows on every hero at once
tactics.goaded: {hero} asks {boss} a question of faith. It cannot leave it unanswered, and while it sermonises the party moves.

tactics.fled: The {foes} cut their losses and slip off down the game trails.
tactics.signature: {boss} springs the snares, and nets and stakes drop across the party
tactics.called: {boss} sounds a hunting horn, and {n} poachers step out of the trees.

tactics.signature: {boss} vents scalding steam across the whole room

tactics.fled: The {foes} sink back into the roots.
tactics.signature: {boss} calls the roots up through the floor to bind the party
